printing.usb_access_denied_windows: USB access to the device was denied (Access Denied). This is not a fault — it is intended Windows behaviour: when the printer has an official driver installed, Windows reserves it exclusively through usbprint.sys and no browser can open it. WebUSB will never work on Windows in this case. The right fix: "Pair with the Seen relay" at the top of this page — it prints silently through the same official driver and also works from Android. Alternatives: "System Printer" via the print dialog, or a network printer via IP address. We do not recommend replacing the driver with WinUSB via Zadig, because that breaks printing from every other program on the machine.
